==Instructions==
This template is to be used for citing individual pages on [https://www.kobo.com Kobo].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use. 

<code><nowiki>{{Kobo|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

====Required parameters====
*{{Para|url}} URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://www.kobo.com/</nowiki></code>).
*{{Para|text}} Name of the page being cited.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{Kobo|url=us/en/ebook/star-wars-classic-stores-the-empire-strikes-back|text=Star Wars Classic Stores: The Empire Strikes Back|archivedate=}}</nowiki></code>

Result in:

{{Kobo|url=us/en/ebook/star-wars-classic-stores-the-empire-strikes-back|text=Star Wars Classic Stores: The Empire Strikes Back|archivedate=}}
